# NextGen Lead Generator

> AI-powered Google Maps scraper created by Muhammad Affaf to find high-intent clients for Web Development, Marketing and Power BI / Fabric agencies across 195 countries. Triple System with Stop Button.

## Summary
NextGen Lead Generator is a Triple Lead System developed by Muhammad Affaf from NextGen Analytics, Karachi, Pakistan. It helps agencies find high-intent clients on Google Maps in 3 minutes across 195 countries. Built with Python, Playwright, Flask, Pandas, Streamlit. 60 leads per search, 70% hot lead rate, 96% email found rate, 2.8min avg time.

## Official Links
- [Landing Page](https://nextgenanalytics.cloud-ip.cc/nextgen-lead-generator/): Full documentation, features, how it works, niches, stats and FAQ
- [Live App Demo](https://nextgen-lead-generator-nxp2zwykt8btyyvsutv42a.streamlit.app/): Working Streamlit app - search any niche like Real Estate, Gyms, Dentists, Restaurants in any city
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/affaf12/nextgen-lead-generator): Open source codebase, MIT license, no API key required
- [Vercel Mirror](https://nextgen-lead-generator.vercel.app/): Fast landing page mirror

## Features
- [Web Development Leads](https://nextgenanalytics.cloud-ip.cc/nextgen-lead-generator/#features): Businesses with no website, dead domain, no SSL, slow speed - Ticket $300-$800
- [Marketing Leads](https://nextgenanalytics.cloud-ip.cc/nextgen-lead-generator/#features): Low rating <4.0, few reviews, missing meta tags - Ticket $400-$1000/mo
- [Power BI / Fabric Leads](https://nextgenanalytics.cloud-ip.cc/nextgen-lead-generator/#features): 100+ reviews but no dashboard system - Ticket $950+ HIGH TICKET
- [How It Works](https://nextgenanalytics.cloud-ip.cc/nextgen-lead-generator/#how-it-works): 3 steps - Define Target, AI Scrapes & Analyzes, Export & Close
- [Stats & Results](https://nextgenanalytics.cloud-ip.cc/nextgen-lead-generator/#stats): Live campaign data from Gyms in Karachi niche
